name: How much does professional urine cleanup cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional urine cleanup cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional urine cleanup varies depending on several factors, including the size of the affected area, the type of surface (e.g., carpet, hardwood, concrete), the severity of the contamination, and the extent of required repairs or material replacement. Companies typically provide an estimate after an on-site inspection. Factors like whether subflooring or multiple layers need treatment will influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on the affected area's size, surface type, severity of contamination, and necessary repairs. An on-site inspection is usually required for an estimate.
